project: AI-Based Website Behavioral Analysis and Tracker Detection System

source.verification_method: first 1000 rows identical to tranco-list.eu download

selection.method: Iterate the Tranco list in ascending rank order; normalise each hostname (lower-case, strip trailing dot); compute its registrable domain (eTLD+1, Public Suffix List). Skip entries whose registrable domain was already selected (so www.example.com and example.com count once), IP literals/unparseable hosts, and hosts listed in the URLhaus malware host list. Take the first N remaining entries.
selection.public_suffix_list: tldextract 5.4.0 bundled Public Suffix List snapshot (ICANN section)

reference.source: DuckDuckGo Tracker Data Set (extension-tds.json, built from DuckDuckGo Tracker Radar)
